title: Cross-repository DWG/DXF fault patterns and AcDs acceptance gate
mode: deeper and broader research; plan refinement only
scope: Review current open-source HATCH parser/writer fault history and edge-case reports
Compare DXF HATCH spline model and consumer-boundary guidance
Refresh modern ACIS/AcDs evidence limits across LibreDWG and ACadSharp
Turn findings into implementation-ready controls in existing local subplans

method.kind: Primary project source, issue/PR state, official DXF documentation, and local plan crosswalk

sources.use: Project history lists HATCH path-local handle/derived state fixes, rational spline knot/weight fix, and current limits around AcDs SAB extraction.
Open peer report for a HATCH group-21 value of zero rejected as if it were absent.
Official group-code mapping for HATCH boundary path and spline-edge fields.
Independent DXF data model for OCS boundary points, separate spline weights, and documented non-validation of edge gaps.
Open report of R2013+ modeler entities surviving while AcDs-carried SAB payload is missing from conversion output.
Open report of ACIS-bearing solid entities silently omitted by the cited ACadSharp DXF writer release.
Open ACIS writer proposal with version-sensitive modeler serialization; not deployed/qualified.
Open ACDS/ACIS schema refactor dependency; discussion reports branch-specific embedded-record test failure and unimplemented reader path at that time.

method.localSourceAudit: No new local source defect was inferred from peer reports. Existing local PAR-115 evidence and ODA authority remain unchanged.
method.limitations: GitHub master/issue/PR pages are mutable. Peer issues document project- and artifact-specific reports, not normative format behavior or libdxfrw defects. ACadSharp PR discussion evidence is branch- and date-specific. LibreDWG/ACadSharp are not ODA byte-layout authorities. No runtime interoperability was performed.

hatch: Reuse existing fast local test owners; add no new target or persistent drawing fixture.
Assert zero-valued HATCH coordinates are preserved independently of field presence.
Exercise at least two paths with distinct path flags and source handles to catch cross-path state bleed.
Keep knot/control/weight counts and streams distinct, then assert the following edge/entity sentinel.
Keep codec field fidelity separate from edge-loop closure and visual fill qualification.
acis_acds: Separate pre-R2013 inline SAT/ACIS from R2013+ external AcDs/SAB storage.
Require entity-to-section/key/owner linkage and exact payload size/digest across conversion.
Treat entity counts and flags alone as insufficient; missing externally referenced payload is loss.
Require an exact pinned merged release/artifact before counting an open-source peer as a qualification route.
Keep stock FreeCAD 2D import separate from modeler add-on/kernel semantic evidence.
implementationRefinement.selfUnblock: If external peer artifacts or native applications remain unavailable, record NOT_QUALIFIED and continue the next local-ready slice; never wait or promote support based on an issue/PR report.
